Specify the following versions in your dependencies for compatibility:\n\n```\n\"react\": \"^18.2.0\"\n\"react-dom\": \"^18.2.0\"\n```\n\nIf your Vite configuration or dependencies default to React 19, downgrade them to React 18 to ensure compatibility with builder-ui-kit and project standards.\n\n## Project Structure\n\nThe following structure applies to both this project and any new Builder.io projects created from this template:\n\n- `/src/components` - Reusable UI components\n- `/src/pages` - Page components for routing. **When creating new pages, add them to the `src/pages` folder.**\n- `/src/utils` - Utility functions\n- `/src/styles` - Global styles and themes\n\n## Builder.io Fusion Tealium Project\n\nIn the Fusion Tealium Project in Builder.io, there is already an indexed Design System named \"tealium-ui-kit\". This helps the AI understand the builder-ui-kit component patterns and coding conventions more effectively.\n\n# Project Overview\n\nThis is a React TypeScript application built with Vite and React Router.\n\n## Design System\n\nThe design system (builder-ui-kit) is included as a local dependency via a .tgz file in this repository. There is no need to connect to a separate design system repository.\n\nFor additional clarity: In this Fusion space template, the `builder-ui-kit` repository is also added to the workspace. This allows direct access to the design system source for reference, support, and best practices.\n\nUse the CSS files in `src/css` (such as `colors-tokens.css`, `fonts-tokens.css`, and `fontawesome.css`) for global styles, color and font tokens, and font integration to ensure consistent styling across the application.\n\n## Fonts Localization\n\nTo localize the font family used for all build projects:\n\n- Font Awesome fonts and styles are located in `public/fontawesome/`.\n- All Proxima font files (e.g., `proxima.*`) are located in the `public/` folder.\n\n**Storybook:**  \nA public Storybook instance for builder-ui-kit components is available at: [VITE_STORYBOOK_URL](https://your-storybook-url.com)  \nA public Storybook instance for builder-ui-kit components is available at the URL specified in the environment variable `VITE_STORYBOOK_URL`. Do not hardcode the URL; set it in your environment or Builder Fusion environment.\n\nUse this as a visual and technical reference for available components, usage examples, and props documentation.\n\n**Note:** `builder-ui-kit` requires `@material-ui/core` (MUI v4) and `styled-components` as peer dependencies. These are included in this project’s dependencies to ensure compatibility and proper usage of the design system components.\n\n## Coding Standards\n\nWhen adding new functionality or enhancements to existing UI-Kit tools, reference the builder-ui-kit code source repository for additional support, implementation details, and best practices.\n\nWhenever possible, use existing builder-ui-kit components when creating pages or new UI features, rather than building components from scratch with HTML tags. This ensures consistency and leverages the design system.\n\nDo NOT use box-shadow or text-shadow in styled components. Only use approved design system styles to maintain consistency.\n\n**Important:** Do NOT use the `<StrictMode>` tag in `src/index.tsx` when building or modifying the project, as it can cause conflicts and crashes with builder-ui-kit and MUI v4.         "content": "# Tealium UI Kit\n\n## Standards\n\n**File Structure**\nThis repo utilizes [Atomic Design](https://bradfrost.com/blog/post/atomic-web-design/), thus components are categorized by atoms, molecules, organisms, templates and pages. Underneath that folder, component folders and files are named in PascalCase.\n\nExample: **\\<TableToolbar/>** component is classified as a molecule, and thus it's path would be **_src/components/molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbar.jsx_**\n\nThe top level src has a components folder for components, and folders for shared common types used throughout the repository (hooks, css, utils, etc).\n\n**Makeup of a component**\nEach component shall have at least 3 files, contained in their own folder:\n\n1.  Source file (*.js)\n2.  Storybook stories file (*.stories.jsx)\n3.  Unit test file (*.test.jsx)\n4.  (optional) Styles file (*.styles.jsx) -- This allows us to separate CSS from the inline business logic.\n\n**Code Coverage**\nThe repository enforces a 98% overall code coverage. Pre-commit hooks and a Jenkins pipeline tests these, along with pre-release checks.\n\n**Other standards tools used**\nAlso utilized are standards tools Prettier and ESLint. Checks are done on pre-push as well as in Jenkins pipelines ensure standards are met.\n\n**Component Generator**\nA [component generator](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1278869850/Component+Generator) was created for both VSCode and Intellij. This takes the guess work out of creating the new files and folders manually.\n\n## How to Contribute\n\n### --> Reference the [Contribution Guide](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/2927101149/UI+Kit+Contribution+Process+Chromatic) ###\n\n### Commit Message\n\nBefore pushing your commit, make note that this repository uses a convention that allows us to do semantic versioning automatically. It's loosely based on the [angular commit messages convention](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).\n\n**Convention**\n\n    <type>(<scope>): <subject>\n    <blank line>\n    <body>\n    <blank line>\n    <footer>\n\n**Accepted Commit [Type Enums](https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/tree/master/%40commitlint/config-conventional#type-enum)**\n\n-   build\n-   chore\n-   ci\n-   docs\n-   feat (increments the minor version)\n-   fix (increments the patch version)\n-   perf\n-   refactor\n-   revert\n-   style\n-   test\n\n**Patch Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v1.0.1)**\nUse type _fix_ to release a patch version. Common use cases are for fixing existing code, or updating styles or prop-types.\n\n    fix(radio): updated radiobutton styles\n\n**Minor/Feature Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v1.1.0)**\nUse types _feat_, _perf_ for a minor/feature release. This is mainly used for new features, or to update performance on existing code.\n\n    feat(toggle): add triple state option to component\n\n**Major/Breaking Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v2.0.0)**\n\n> **IF YOU NEED TO DO A BREAKING CHANGE, YOU MUST CONSULT THE CORE UI/UX TEAM**\n\nYou can use any type for this, but as your footer, you need to add _BREAKING CHANGE: \\<reason>_. Only use this if interfaces on a component will drastically change, thus making consumers refactor their code in order for it to work. The general format should be _WHY_ the change was made and _WHAT_ the change does. Extra information can be included as well, if needed.\n\n    fix(table): updated table to accept different type of data object for cells\n\n    BREAKING CHANGE: The original interface was too complicated, and added a lot of complexity in running.\n    This change allows for more readability and better performance.  Existing consumers need to update\n    existing code to reflect changes.\n\n### IMPORTANT!!! index.js for named exports\n\nIn order for a newly made component to be importable, be sure to add the named export into src/index.js. **This is very important to allow your component to be consumed, please do not forget this step.**\n\n### Code Reviews/Pull Requests\n\nMerging to the main branch is managed by approved reviewers, see the `CODEOWNERS` file. After the code is reviewed, they will approve and merge the request.\n\n### Symbolic Links\n\n> THIS IS OUT OF DATE, NPM 6 BREAKS THIS METHOD.  UNTIL WE CAN MOVE FORWARD TO NPM 8, THE INSTRUCTIONS ARE DIFFERENT.\n\nTo test your changes as the consumer of the repository in UTUI for example, use [symbolic links](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1270481958/Symbolic+links+with+UTUI) to accomplish this.\n\n## Jenkins Pipeline\n\nPlease refer to the [confluence page](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1430192495/Jenkins+Pipeline) for information on how the pipeline currently is implemented.\n",

PPPpp   | May 29th, 1453 at ...             |       |\\n * |                                 |     | PPPPpp  | Sunday, May 29th, 1453 at ...     | 2,5,8 |\\n * Notes:\\n * 1. \\\"Formatting\\\" units |                                 | PPPPpppp| Friday, April 29th, 1453 at ...   | 2,7   |\\n * Notes:\\n * 1. \\\"Formatting\\\" units (e.g. formatting quarter) in the default en-US locale\\n *    are remL < yL;) rem[remL++] = 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n      yz = yd.slice();\\r\\n      yz.unshift(0);\\r\\n      yd0 = yd[0];\\r\\n\\r\\n      if (yd[1] >= BASE / 2) ++yd0;\\r\\n\\r\\n      do {\\r\\n        k = 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n        // Compare divisor and remainder.\\r\\n        cmp = compare(yd, rem, yL, remL);\\r\\n\\r\\n        // If divisor < remainder.\\r\\n        if (cmp < 0) {\\r\\n\\r\\n          // Calculate trial digit, k.\\r\\n          rem0 = rem[0];\\r\\n          if (yL != remL) rem0 = rem0 * BASE + (rem[1] || 0);\\r\\n\\r\\n          // k will be how many times the divisor goes into the current remainder.\\r\\n          k = rem0 / yd0 | 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n          //  Algorithm:\\r\\n          //  1. product = divisor * trial digit (k)\\r\\n          //  2. if product > remainder: product -= divisor, k--\\r\\n          //  3. remainder -= product\\r\\n          //  4. if product was < remainder at 2:\\r\\n          //    5. compare new remainder and divisor\\r\\n          //    6. If remainder > divisor: remainder -= divisor, k++\\r\\n\\r\\n          if (k > 1) {\\r\\n            if (k >= BASE) k = BASE - 1;\\r\\n\\r\\n            // product = divisor * trial digit.\\r\\n            prod = multiplyInteger(yd, k);\\r\\n            prodL = prod.length;\\r\\n            remL = rem.length;\\r\\n\\r\\n            // Compare product and remainder.\\r\\n            cmp = compare(prod, rem, prodL, remL);\\r\\n\\r\\n            // product > remainder.\\r\\n            if (cmp == 1) {\\r\\n              k--;\\r\\n\\r\\n              // Subtract divisor from product.\\r\\n              subtract(prod, yL < prodL ? yz : yd, prodL);\\r\\n            }\\r\\n          } else {\\r\\n\\r\\n            // cmp is -1.\\r\\n            // If k is 0, there is no need to compare yd and rem again below, so change cmp to 1\\r\\n            // to avoid it. If k is 1 there is a need to compare yd and rem again below.\\r\\n            if (k == 0) cmp = k = 1;\\r\\n            prod = yd.slice();\\r\\n          }\\r\\n\\r\\n          prodL = prod.length;\\r\\n          if (prodL < remL) prod.unshift(0);\\r\\n\\r\\n          // Subtract product from remainder.\\r\\n          subtract(rem, prod, remL);\\r\\n\\r\\n          // If product was < previous remainder.\\r\\n          if (cmp == -1) {\\r\\n            remL = rem.length;\\r\\n\\r\\n            // Compare divisor and new remainder.\\r\\n            cmp = compare(yd, rem, yL, remL);\\r\\n\\r\\n            // If divisor < new remainder, subtract divisor from remainder.\\r\\n            if (cmp < 1) {\\r\\n              k++;\\r\\n\\r\\n              // Subtract divisor from remainder.\\r\\n              subtract(rem, yL < remL ? yz : yd, remL);\\r\\n            }\\r\\n          }\\r\\n\\r\\n          remL = rem.length;\\r\\n        } else if (cmp === 0) {\\r\\n          k++;\\r\\n          rem = [0];\\r\\n        }    // if cmp === 1, k will be 0\\r\\n\\r\\n        // Add the next digit, k, to the result array.\\r\\n        qd[i++] = k;\\r\\n\\r\\n        // Update the remainder.\\r\\n        if (cmp && rem[0]) {\\r\\n          rem[remL++] = xd[xi] || 0;\\r\\n        } else {\\r\\n          rem = [xd[xi]];\\r\\n          remL = 1;\\r\\n        }\\r\\n\\r\\n      } while ((xi++ < xL || rem[0] !== void 0) && sd--);\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Leading zero?\\r\\n    if (!qd[0]) qd.shift();\\r\\n\\r\\n    q.e = e;\\r\\n\\r\\n    return round(q, dp ? pr + getBase10Exponent(q) + 1 : pr);\\r\\n  };\\r\\n})();\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n/*\\r\\n * Return a new Decimal whose value is the natural exponential of `x` truncated to `sd`\\r\\n * significant digits.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Taylor/Maclaurin series.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * exp(x) = x^0/0! + x^1/1! + x^2/2! + x^3/3! + ...\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Argument reduction:\\r\\n *   Repeat x = x / 32, k += 5, until |x| < 0.1\\r\\n *   exp(x) = exp(x / 2^k)^(2^k)\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Previously, the argument was initially reduced by\\r\\n * exp(x) = exp(r) * 10^k  where r = x - k * ln10, k = floor(x / ln10)\\r\\n * to first put r in the range [0, ln10], before dividing by 32 until |x| < 0.1, but this was\\r\\n * found to be slower than just dividing repeatedly by 32 as above.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * (Math object integer min/max: Math.exp(709) = 8.2e+307, Math.exp(-745) = 5e-324)\\r\\n *\\r\\n *  exp(x) is non-terminating for any finite, non-zero x.\\r\\n *\\r\\n */\\r\\nfunction exp(x, sd) {\\r\\n  var denominator, guard, pow, sum, t, wpr,\\r\\n    i = 0,\\r\\n    k = 0,\\r\\n    Ctor = x.constructor,\\r\\n    pr = Ctor.precision;\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (getBase10Exponent(x) > 16) throw Error(exponentOutOfRange + getBase10Exponent(x));\\r\\n\\r\\n  // exp(0) = 1\\r\\n  if (!x.s) return new Ctor(ONE);\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (sd == null) {\\r\\n    external = false;\\r\\n    wpr = pr;\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n    wpr = sd;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  t = new Ctor(0.03125);\\r\\n\\r\\n  while (x.abs().gte(0.1)) {\\r\\n    x = x.times(t);    // x = x / 2^5\\r\\n    k += 5;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Estimate the precision increase necessary to ensure the first 4 rounding digits are correct.\\r\\n  guard = Math.log(mathpow(2, k)) / Math.LN10 * 2 + 5 | 0;\\r\\n  wpr += guard;\\r\\n  denominator = pow = sum = new Ctor(ONE);\\r\\n  Ctor.precision = wpr;\\r\\n\\r\\n  for (;;) {\\r\\n    pow = round(pow.times(x), wpr);\\r\\n    denominator = denominator.times(++i);\\r\\n    t = sum.plus(divide(pow, denominator, wpr));\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (digitsToString(t.d).slice(0, wpr) === digitsToString(sum.d).slice(0, wpr)) {\\r\\n      while (k--) sum = round(sum.times(sum), wpr);\\r\\n      Ctor.precision = pr;\\r\\n      return sd == null ? (external = true, round(sum, pr)) : sum;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    sum = t;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n// Calculate the base 10 exponent from the base 1e7 exponent.\\r\\nfunction getBase10Exponent(x) {\\r\\n  var e = x.e * LOG_BASE,\\r\\n    w = x.d[0];\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Add the number of digits of the first word of the digits array.\\r\\n  for (; w >= 10; w /= 10) e++;\\r\\n  return e;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction getLn10(Ctor, sd, pr) {\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (sd > Ctor.LN10.sd()) {\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Reset global state in case the exception is caught.\\r\\n    external = true;\\r\\n    if (pr) Ctor.precision = pr;\\r\\n    throw Error(decimalError + 'LN10 precision limit exceeded');\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  return round(new Ctor(Ctor.LN10), sd);\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction getZeroString(k) {\\r\\n  var zs = '';\\r\\n  for (; k--;) zs += '0';\\r\\n  return zs;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n/*\\r\\n * Return a new Decimal whose value is the natural logarithm of `x` truncated to `sd` significant\\r\\n * digits.\\r\\n *\\r\\n *  ln(n) is non-terminating (n != 1)\\r\\n *\\r\\n */\\r\\nfunction ln(y, sd) {\\r\\n  var c, c0, denominator, e, numerator, sum, t, wpr, x2,\\r\\n    n = 1,\\r\\n    guard = 10,\\r\\n    x = y,\\r\\n    xd = x.d,\\r\\n    Ctor = x.constructor,\\r\\n    pr = Ctor.precision;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // ln(-x) = NaN\\r\\n  // ln(0) = -Infinity\\r\\n  if (x.s < 1) throw Error(decimalError + (x.s ? 'NaN' : '-Infinity'));\\r\\n\\r\\n  // ln(1) = 0\\r\\n  if (x.eq(ONE)) return new Ctor(0);\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (sd == null) {\\r\\n    external = false;\\r\\n    wpr = pr;\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n    wpr = sd;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (x.eq(10)) {\\r\\n    if (sd == null) external = true;\\r\\n    return getLn10(Ctor, wpr);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  wpr += guard;\\r\\n  Ctor.precision = wpr;\\r\\n  c = digitsToString(xd);\\r\\n  c0 = c.charAt(0);\\r\\n  e = getBase10Exponent(x);\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (Math.abs(e) < 1.5e15) {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Argument reduction.\\r\\n    // The series converges faster the closer the argument is to 1, so using\\r\\n    // ln(a^b) = b * ln(a),   ln(a) = ln(a^b) / b\\r\\n    // multiply the argument by itself until the leading digits of the significand are 7, 8, 9,\\r\\n    // 10, 11, 12 or 13, recording the number of multiplications so the sum of the series can\\r\\n    // later be divided by this number, then separate out the power of 10 using\\r\\n    // ln(a*10^b) = ln(a) + b*ln(10).\\r\\n\\r\\n    // max n is 21 (gives 0.9, 1.0 or 1.1) (9e15 / 21 = 4.2e14).\\r\\n    //while (c0 < 9 && c0 != 1 || c0 == 1 && c.charAt(1) > 1) {\\r\\n    // max n is 6 (gives 0.7 - 1.3)\\r\\n    while (c0 < 7 && c0 != 1 || c0 == 1 && c.charAt(1) > 3) {\\r\\n      x = x.times(y);\\r\\n      c = digitsToString(x.d);\\r\\n      c0 = c.charAt(0);\\r\\n      n++;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    e = getBase10Exponent(x);\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (c0 > 1) {\\r\\n      x = new Ctor('0.' + c);\\r\\n      e++;\\r\\n    } else {\\r\\n      x = new Ctor(c0 + '.' + c.slice(1));\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // The argument reduction method above may result in overflow if the argument y is a massive\\r\\n    // number with exponent >= 1500000000000000 (9e15 / 6 = 1.5e15), so instead recall this\\r\\n    // function using ln(x*10^e) = ln(x) + e*ln(10).\\r\\n    t = getLn10(Ctor, wpr + 2, pr).times(e + '');\\r\\n    x = ln(new Ctor(c0 + '.' + c.slice(1)), wpr - guard).plus(t);\\r\\n\\r\\n    Ctor.precision = pr;\\r\\n    return sd == null ? (external = true, round(x, pr)) : x;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  // x is reduced to a value near 1.\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Taylor series.\\r\\n  // ln(y) = ln((1 + x)/(1 - x)) = 2(x + x^3/3 + x^5/5 + x^7/7 + ...)\\r\\n  // where x = (y - 1)/(y + 1)    (|x| < 1)\\r\\n  sum = numerator = x = divide(x.minus(ONE), x.plus(ONE), wpr);\\r\\n  x2 = round(x.times(x), wpr);\\r\\n  denominator = 3;\\r\\n\\r\\n  for (;;) {\\r\\n    numerator = round(numerator.times(x2), wpr);\\r\\n    t = sum.plus(divide(numerator, new Ctor(denominator), wpr));\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (digitsToString(t.d).slice(0, wpr) === digitsToString(sum.d).slice(0, wpr)) {\\r\\n      sum = sum.times(2);\\r\\n\\r\\n      // Reverse the argument reduction.\\r\\n      if (e !== 0) sum = sum.plus(getLn10(Ctor, wpr + 2, pr).times(e + ''));\\r\\n      sum = divide(sum, new Ctor(n), wpr);\\r\\n\\r\\n      Ctor.precision = pr;\\r\\n      return sd == null ? (external = true, round(sum, pr)) : sum;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    sum = t;\\r\\n    denominator += 2;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n/*\\r\\n * Parse the value of a new Decimal `x` from string `str`.\\r\\n */\\r\\nfunction parseDecimal(x, str) {\\r\\n  var e, i, len;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Decimal point?\\r\\n  if ((e = str.indexOf('.')) > -1) str = str.replace('.', '');\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Exponential form?\\r\\n  if ((i = str.search(/e/i)) > 0) {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Determine exponent.\\r\\n    if (e < 0) e = i;\\r\\n    e += +str.slice(i + 1);\\r\\n    str = str.substring(0, i);\\r\\n  } else if (e < 0) {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Integer.\\r\\n    e = str.length;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Determine leading zeros.\\r\\n  for (i = 0; str.charCodeAt(i) === 48;) ++i;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Determine trailing zeros.\\r\\n  for (len = str.length; str.charCodeAt(len - 1) === 48;) --len;\\r\\n  str = str.slice(i, len);\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (str) {\\r\\n    len -= i;\\r\\n    e = e - i - 1;\\r\\n    x.e = mathfloor(e / LOG_BASE);\\r\\n    x.d = [];\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Transform base\\r\\n\\r\\n    // e is the base 10 exponent.\\r\\n    // i is where to slice str to get the first word of the digits array.\\r\\n    i = (e + 1) % LOG_BASE;\\r\\n    if (e < 0) i += LOG_BASE;\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (i < len) {\\r\\n      if (i) x.d.push(+str.slice(0, i));\\r\\n      for (len -= LOG_BASE; i < len;) x.d.push(+str.slice(i, i += LOG_BASE));\\r\\n      str = str.slice(i);\\r\\n      i = LOG_BASE - str.length;\\r\\n    } else {\\r\\n      i -= len;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    for (; i--;) str += '0';\\r\\n    x.d.push(+str);\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (external && (x.e > MAX_E || x.e < -MAX_E)) throw Error(exponentOutOfRange + e);\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Zero.\\r\\n    x.s = 0;\\r\\n    x.e = 0;\\r\\n    x.d = [0];\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  return x;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n/*\\r\\n * Round `x` to `sd` significant digits, using rounding mode `rm` if present (truncate otherwise).\\r\\n */\\r\\n function round(x, sd, rm) {\\r\\n  var i, j, k, n, rd, doRound, w, xdi,\\r\\n    xd = x.d;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // rd: the rounding digit, i.e. the digit after the digit that may be rounded up.\\r\\n  // w: the word of xd which contains the rounding digit, a base 1e7 number.\\r\\n  // xdi: the index of w within xd.\\r\\n  // n: the number of digits of w.\\r\\n  // i: what would be the index of rd within w if all the numbers were 7 digits long (i.e. if\\r\\n  // they had leading zeros)\\r\\n  // j: if > 0, the actual index of rd within w (if < 0, rd is a leading zero).\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Get the length of the first word of the digits array xd.\\r\\n  for (n = 1, k = xd[0]; k >= 10; k /= 10) n++;\\r\\n  i = sd - n;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Is the rounding digit in the first word of xd?\\r\\n  if (i < 0) {\\r\\n    i += LOG_BASE;\\r\\n    j = sd;\\r\\n    w = xd[xdi = 0];\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n    xdi = Math.ceil((i + 1) / LOG_BASE);\\r\\n    k = xd.length;\\r\\n    if (xdi >= k) return x;\\r\\n    w = k = xd[xdi];\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Get the number of digits of w.\\r\\n    for (n = 1; k >= 10; k /= 10) n++;\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Get the index of rd within w.\\r\\n    i %= LOG_BASE;\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Get the index of rd within w, adjusted for leading zeros.\\r\\n    // The number of leading zeros of w is given by LOG_BASE - n.\\r\\n    j = i - LOG_BASE + n;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (rm !== void 0) {\\r\\n    k = mathpow(10, n - j - 1);\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Get the rounding digit at index j of w.\\r\\n    rd = w / k % 10 | 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Are there any non-zero digits after the rounding digit?\\r\\n    doRound = sd < 0 || xd[xdi + 1] !== void 0 || w % k;\\r\\n\\r\\n    // The expression `w % mathpow(10, n - j - 1)` returns all the digits of w to the right of the\\r\\n    // digit at (left-to-right) index j, e.g. if w is 908714 and j is 2, the expression will give\\r\\n    // 714.\\r\\n\\r\\n    doRound = rm < 4\\r\\n      ? (rd || doRound) && (rm == 0 || rm == (x.s < 0 ? 3 : 2))\\r\\n      : rd > 5 || rd == 5 && (rm == 4 || doRound || rm == 6 &&\\r\\n\\r\\n        // Check whether the digit to the left of the rounding digit is odd.\\r\\n        ((i > 0 ? j > 0 ? w / mathpow(10, n - j) : 0 : xd[xdi - 1]) % 10) & 1 ||\\r\\n          rm == (x.s < 0 ? 8 : 7));\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (sd < 1 || !xd[0]) {\\r\\n    if (doRound) {\\r\\n      k = getBase10Exponent(x);\\r\\n      xd.length = 1;\\r\\n\\r\\n      // Convert sd to decimal places.\\r\\n      sd = sd - k - 1;\\r\\n\\r\\n      // 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001 etc.\\r\\n      xd[0] = mathpow(10, (LOG_BASE - sd % LOG_BASE) % LOG_BASE);\\r\\n      x.e = mathfloor(-sd / LOG_BASE) || 0;\\r\\n    } else {\\r\\n      xd.length = 1;\\r\\n\\r\\n      // Zero.\\r\\n      xd[0] = x.e = x.s = 0;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    return x;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Remove excess digits.\\r\\n  if (i == 0) {\\r\\n    xd.length = xdi;\\r\\n    k = 1;\\r\\n    xdi--;\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n    xd.length = xdi + 1;\\r\\n    k = mathpow(10, LOG_BASE - i);\\r\\n\\r\\n    // E.g. 56700 becomes 56000 if 7 is the rounding digit.\\r\\n    // j > 0 means i > number of leading zeros of w.\\r\\n    xd[xdi] = j > 0 ? (w / mathpow(10, n - j) % mathpow(10, j) | 0) * k : 0;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (doRound) {\\r\\n    for (;;) {\\r\\n\\r\\n      // Is the digit to be rounded up in the first word of xd?\\r\\n      if (xdi == 0) {\\r\\n        if ((xd[0] += k) == BASE) {\\r\\n          xd[0] = 1;\\r\\n          ++x.e;\\r\\n        }\\r\\n\\r\\n        break;\\r\\n      } else {\\r\\n        xd[xdi] += k;\\r\\n        if (xd[xdi] != BASE) break;\\r\\n        xd[xdi--] = 0;\\r\\n        k = 1;\\r\\n      }\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Remove trailing zeros.\\r\\n  for (i = xd.length; xd[--i] === 0;) xd.pop();\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (external && (x.e > MAX_E || x.e < -MAX_E)) {\\r\\n    throw Error(exponentOutOfRange + getBase10Exponent(x));\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  return x;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\nfunction subtract(x, y) {\\r\\n  var d, e, i, j, k, len, xd, xe, xLTy, yd,\\r\\n    Ctor = x.constructor,\\r\\n    pr = Ctor.precision;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Return y negated if x is zero.\\r\\n  // Return x if y is zero and x is non-zero.\\r\\n  if (!x.s || !y.s) {\\r\\n    if (y.s) y.s = -y.s;\\r\\n    else y = new Ctor(x);\\r\\n    return external ? round(y, pr) : y;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  xd = x.d;\\r\\n  yd = y.d;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // x and y are non-zero numbers with the same sign.\\r\\n\\r\\n  e = y.e;\\r\\n  xe = x.e;\\r\\n  xd = xd.slice();\\r\\n  k = xe - e;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // If exponents differ...\\r\\n  if (k) {\\r\\n    xLTy = k < 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (xLTy) {\\r\\n      d = xd;\\r\\n      k = -k;\\r\\n      len = yd.length;\\r\\n    } else {\\r\\n      d = yd;\\r\\n      e = xe;\\r\\n      len = xd.length;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Numbers with massively different exponents would result in a very high number of zeros\\r\\n    // needing to be prepended, but this can be avoided while still ensuring correct rounding by\\r\\n    // limiting the number of zeros to `Math.ceil(pr / LOG_BASE) + 2`.\\r\\n    i = Math.max(Math.ceil(pr / LOG_BASE), len) + 2;\\r\\n\\r\\n    if (k > i) {\\r\\n      k = i;\\r\\n      d.length = 1;\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Prepend zeros to equalise exponents.\\r\\n    d.reverse();\\r\\n    for (i = k; i--;) d.push(0);\\r\\n    d.reverse();\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Base 1e7 exponents equal.\\r\\n  } else {\\r\\n\\r\\n    // Check digits to determine which is the bigger number.\\r\\n\\r\\n    i = xd.length;\\r\\n    len = yd.length;\\r\\n    xLTy = i < len;\\r\\n    if (xLTy) len = i;\\r\\n\\r\\n    for (i = 0; i < len; i++) {\\r\\n      if (xd[i] != yd[i]) {\\r\\n        xLTy = xd[i] < yd[i];\\r\\n        break;\\r\\n      }\\r\\n    }\\r\\n\\r\\n    k = 0;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  if (xLTy) {\\r\\n    d = xd;\\r\\n    xd = yd;\\r\\n    yd = d;\\r\\n    y.s = -y.s;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n\\r\\n  len = xd.length;\\r\\n\\r\\n  // Append zeros to xd if shorter.\\r\\n  // Don't add zeros to yd if shorter as subtraction only needs to start at yd length.\\r\\n  for (i = yd.length - len; };\n\n  // ─── Instance Editing Handlers ──────────────────────────────\n\n  const handleToggle = (instId: string, val: boolean) => {\n    setInstances((prev) => prev.map((i) => (i.id === instId ? { \"new\",\"true\",\"false\",\"null\",\"undefined\",\"typeof\",\"instanceof\",\"this\",\"class\",\n    \"import\",\"export\",\"default\",\"from\",\"await\",\"async\",\"try\",\"catch\",\"throw\",\n    \"switch\",\"case\",\"break\",\"continue\",\n  ]);\n  const BUILTINS = new Set([\n    \"console\",\"Math\",\"Date\",\"Object\",\"Array\",\"JSON\",\"Map\",\"Set\",\"Promise\",\"Error\",\n  ]);\n\n  // /\\/\\*[\\s\\S]*?\\*\\/|\\/\\/[^\\n]*|\"(?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*\"|'(?:[^'\\\\]|\\\\.)*'|`(?:[^`\\\\]|\\\\.)*`|\\b\\d+\\.?\\d*\\b|[a-zA-Z_$][a-zA-Z0-9_$]*/g;\n\n  let result = \"\";\n  let lastIndex = class=\"hl-comment\">${escaped}</span>`;\n    } else if (tok.startsWith('\"') || tok.startsWith(\"'\") || tok.startsWith(\"`\")) {\n      result += `<span class=\"hl-string\">${escaped}</span>`;\n  } else if (BUILTINS.has(tok)) {\n      result += `<span class=\"hl-builtin\">${escaped}</span>`;\n    } else {\n      result += escaped;\n    }\n\n    lastIndex = match.index + tok.length;\n  }\n\n { ...p, description: val } : p));\n  };\n\n  const handleAddOutputParam = () => {\n    setOutputParams((prev) => [...prev, { id: `p${Date.now()}`, variableName: \"\", type: \"String\", description: \"\" }]);\n  };\n\n  const handleRemoveOutputParam = (paramId: string) => {\n    setOutputParams((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== paramId));\n  };\n\n  const handleOutputParamNameChange = (paramId: string, newName: string) => {\n    setOutputParams((prev) => prev.map((p) => p.id === paramId ? { ...p, variableName: newName } : p));\n  };\n\n  const handleOutputParamTypeChange = (paramId: string, val: any) => {\n    const typeVal = val?.value ?? val;\n    setOutputParams((prev) => prev.map((p) => p.id === paramId ? { ...p, type: typeVal } : p));\n  };\n\n  const handleOutputParamDescChange = (paramId: string, val: string) => {\n    setOutputParams((prev) => prev.map((p) => p.id === paramId ? { ...p, description: val } : p));\n  };\n\n  const positionToActiveMap: Record<string, string> = {\n    preEvent: \"eventBefore\",\n    postEvent: \"eventAfter\",\n    preVisitor: \"visitBefore\",\n    postVisitor: \"visitAfterStd\",\n    postAudience: \"visitAfterAud\",\n  };\n\n  const activePositionSet = new Set(allowedPositions.map((p) => positionToActiveMap[p]).filter(Boolean));\n\n  // ── Marketplace unlock / save ────────────────────────────────────\n  const handleUnlock = () => {\n    setUnlocked(true);\n    if (id) unlockExtension(id);\n  };\n\n  // ── Marketplace update flow ──────────────────────────────────────\n  // Run only the customer's own tests against the pending publisher version,\n  // so they can validate the update before applying it.\n  const handleTestBeforeUpdate = () => {\n    const mine = testCases.filter((t) => t.owner === \"customer\");\n    setCollapsed((prev) => ({ ...prev, tests: false }));\n    document.getElementById(\"test-explorer-section\")?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: \"smooth\", block: \"start\" });\n    if (mine.length === 0) {\n      setPreUpdateTest(\"none\");\n      return;\n    }\n    setPreUpdateTest(\"running\");\n    const mineIds = new Set(mine.map((t) => t.id));\n    setTestCases((prev) => prev.map((t) => mineIds.has(t.id) ? { ...t, status: \"idle\" as const, duration: 0, error: undefined } : t));\n    setExpandedTests((prev) => new Set([...prev, ...mine.map((t) => t.id)]));\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      setTestCases((prev) => prev.map((t) => mineIds.has(t.id) ? { ...t, status: \"pass\" as const, duration: Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1 } : t));\n      setPreUpdateTest(\"passed\");\n    }, 800);\n  };\n\n  const handleApplyUpdate = () => {\n    if (!id) return;\n    updateExtension(id);\n    setJustUpdated(true);\n    setPreUpdateTest(\"idle\");\n  };\n\n  const handleSave = () => {\n    if (isMarketplace && id && catalogItem) {\n      // Detect divergence from the currently-stored version so we only flag\n      // the definition as \"modified\" when something actually changed.\n      const baseName = addedRecord?.overrides?.name ?? catalogItem.name;\n      const baseDesc = addedRecord?.overrides?.description ?? catalogItem.description;\n      const baseCode = addedRecord?.overrides?.code ?? catalogItem.code;\n      const changed = name !== baseName || description !== baseDesc || codeBody !== baseCode;\n      if (changed) {\n        markModified(id, { name, description, code: codeBody });\n      }\n    }\n    navigate(\"/extensions\");\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"module-editor-page\">\n      {/* Breadcrumb */}\n      <nav className=\"editor-breadcrumb\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          className=\"breadcrumb-link\"\n          onClick={() => navigate(\"/extensions\")}\n        >\n          Extension Definitions\n        </button>\n        <span className=\"breadcrumb-separator\">/</span>\n        <span className=\"breadcrumb-current\">\n          {isNew ? \"New Extension\" : name}\n        </span>\n      </nav>\n\n      <div className=\"editor-title-row\">\n        <h1 className=\"editor-page-title\">\n          {isNew ? \"New Extension\" : \"Edit Extension\"}\n        </h1>\n        <div className=\"editor-title-right\">\n          <button type=\"button\" className=\"test-ai-btn\" onClick={() => window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(\"open-ai-builder\", { detail: { prompt: isNew ? \"Help me generate a new extension\" : `Improve or explain the ${name} extension` } }))}>\n            <i className=\"fas fa-magic\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> {isNew ? \"Generate\" : \"Improve / Explain\"}\n          </button>\n          {!isNew && (\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              className=\"editor-instances-top-link\"\n              onClick={() => navigate(`/instances?ext=${id}`)}\n            >\n              <i className=\"fas fa-cubes\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n              {instanceCount} instance{instanceCount !== 1 ? \"s\" : \"\"}\n            </button>\n          )}\n          {!isNew && (\n            <div className=\"editor-extension-toggle\">\n              <span className={`editor-toggle-label ${extensionEnabled ? \"\" : \"editor-toggle-label-off\"}`}>\n                {extensionEnabled ? \"Enabled\" : \"Disabled\"}\n              </span>\n              <SimpleSwitch\n                isStandAlone\n                on={extensionEnabled}\n                onChange={setExtensionEnabled}\n                inputProps={{ \"aria-label\": `Toggle extension ${name}` }}\n              />\n            </div>\n          )}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n\n      {/* Marketplace provenance card — always shows where this definition came\n          from (publisher, published version + date) and its current status. */}\n      {isMarketplace && catalogItem && (\n        <div className={`editor-mkt-card ${locked ? \"editor-mkt-card-locked\" : addedRecord?.modified ? \"editor-mkt-card-modified\" : \"editor-mkt-card-unlocked\"}`}>\n          <div className=\"editor-mkt-card-header\">\n            <span className=\"editor-mkt-card-badge\">\n              <i className=\"fas fa-shopping-bag\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n              Marketplace extension\n            </span>\n            {locked ? (\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-status editor-mkt-status-locked\">\n                <i className=\"fas fa-lock\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Read-only\n              </span>\n            ) : addedRecord?.modified ? (\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-status editor-mkt-status-modified\">\n                <i className=\"fas fa-pen\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Modified\n              </span>\n            ) : (\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-status editor-mkt-status-unlocked\">\n                <i className=\"fas fa-lock-open\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Unlocked\n              </span>\n            )}\n            {locked && (\n              <Button type=\"primary\" onClick={handleUnlock} attrProps={{ className: \"editor-mkt-card-unlock\" }}>\n                <i className=\"fas fa-lock-open\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                <span>Unlock to edit</span>\n              </Button>\n            )}\n          </div>\n\n          <div className=\"editor-mkt-meta\">\n            <div className=\"editor-mkt-meta-item\">\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-label\">Publisher</span>\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-value\">\n                {catalogItem.publisher}\n                {catalogItem.verified && (\n                  <i className=\"fas fa-circle-check editor-mkt-verified\" aria-hidden=\"true\" title=\"Verified publisher\" />\n                )}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"editor-mkt-meta-item\">\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-label\">Installed version</span>\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-value\">v{installedVersion}</span>\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"editor-mkt-meta-item\">\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-label\">Published</span>\n              <span className=\"editor-mkt-meta-value\">\n                v{catalogItem.version}\n                {catalogItem.publishedAt && <> &middot; {formatDate(catalogItem.publishedAt)}</>}\n              </span>\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <p className=\"editor-mkt-explain\">\n            {locked ? (\n              <>\n                This definition matches {catalogItem.publisher}&apos;s published version and is\n                read-only. Unlock it to customize; your changes will then be tracked separately from\n                the publisher&apos;s version.\n              </>\n            ) : addedRecord?.modified ? (\n              <>\n                <strong>Modified</strong> means your team has customized this from{\" \"}\n                {catalogItem.publisher}&apos;s published v{installedVersion}\n                {addedRecord.modifiedBy && <> — last changed by {addedRecord.modifiedBy} on {formatWhen(addedRecord.modifiedAt)}</>}.\n                Publisher updates won&apos;t overwrite your changes automatically.\n              </>\n            ) : (\n              <>\n                Unlocked for editing but still identical to {catalogItem.publisher}&apos;s published\n                version. Saving any change will mark this definition as <strong>modified</strong>.\n              </>\n            )}\n          </p>\n        </div>\n      )}\n\n      {/* Update-available callout — only for locked (unmodified) capsules. */}\n      {isMarketplace && catalogItem && hasUpdate && (\n        <div className=\"editor-update-banner\">\n          <div className=\"editor-update-head\">\n            <span className=\"editor-update-icon\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n              <i className=\"fas fa-arrow-up\" />\n            </span>\n            <div className=\"editor-update-text\">\n              <strong>Update available — v{installedVersion} &rarr; v{catalogItem.version}</strong>\n              {catalogItem.changelog && <p className=\"editor-update-changelog\">{catalogItem.changelog}</p>}\n            </div>\n          </div>\n\n          <div className=\"editor-update-actions\">\n            {preUpdateTest === \"passed\" ? (\n              <span className=\"editor-update-test-result editor-update-test-pass\">\n                <i className=\"fas fa-check-circle\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Your tests passed against v{catalogItem.version}\n              </span>\n            ) : preUpdateTest === \"none\" ? (\n              <span className=\"editor-update-test-result editor-update-test-warn\">\n                <i className=\"fas fa-exclamation-circle\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> No tests of your own yet — add some below to validate first\n              </span>\n            ) : (\n              <span className=\"editor-update-hint\">Recommended: run your own tests against the new version first.</span>\n            )}\n            <div className=\"editor-update-buttons\">\n              <Button type=\"border\" onClick={handleTestBeforeUpdate} attrProps={{ disabled: preUpdateTest === \"running\" }}>\n                <i className={`fas ${preUpdateTest === \"running\" ? \"right\" : \"down\"}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            Extension Details\n          </h2>\n        </div>\n        {!collapsed.details && (\n          <>\n            <div className=\"editor-field\">\n              <label className=\"editor-field-label\">Extension Name</label>\n              <Textbox\n                value={name}\n                onChange={setName}\n                placeholder=\"e.g., Compute Engagement Score\"\n                isFullWidth\n              />\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"editor-field\">\n              <label className=\"editor-field-label\">\n                Description\n                <span className=\"editor-field-optional\">(optional)</span>\n              </label>\n              <div className=\"editor-textarea-wrapper\">\n                <TextArea\n                  value={description}\n                  onChange={setDescription}\n                  placeholder=\"Describe what this extension does...\"\n                  height=\"80px\"\n                  width=\"100%\"\n                />\n              </div>\n            </div>\n          </>\n        )}\n      </section>\n\n      {/* Execution Timing — hero section */}\n      <section className=\"editor-section editor-section-hero\">\n        <div className=\"editor-section-header editor-section-header-collapsible\" onClick={() => toggle(\"timing\")}>\n          <h2 className=\"editor-section-title\">\n            <i className={`fas fa-chevron-${collapsed.timing ? \"right\" : \"down\"}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            Execution Timing\n          </h2>\n          <span onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>\n            <SimpleTooltip title=\"Server-side extensions are replay-safe and participate in event replay during visitor stitching.\">\n              <i className=\"fas fa-info-circle editor-section-info\" />\n            </SimpleTooltip>\n          </span>\n        </div>\n\n        {!collapsed.timing && <>\n        {/* Inline pipeline diagram */}\n        <div className=\"editor-pipeline\">\n          <div className=\"pipeline-flow-rows\">\n            {/* Event phase */}\n            {!isMvp && (\n              <div className=\"pipeline-phase\">\n                <span className=\"pipeline-phase-label\">Event</span>\n                <div className=\"pipeline-flow\">\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-step\">Event Received</span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-step\">Functions</span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                  <span\n                    className={`pipeline-step ${activePositionSet.has(\"eventBefore\") ? \"pipeline-step-active\" : \"pipeline-step-module-off\"}`}\n                  >\n                    <i className=\"fas fa-code\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Pre-Event\n                  </span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-step\">Event Enrichments</span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                  <span\n                    className={`pipeline-step ${activePositionSet.has(\"eventAfter\") ? \"pipeline-step-active\" : \"pipeline-step-module-off\"}`}\n                  >\n                    <i className=\"fas fa-code\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Post-Event\n                  </span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-step pipeline-step-dimmed\">Event Activations</span>\n                </div>\n              </div>\n            )}\n            {/* Visit/Visitor phase */}\n            <div className=\"pipeline-phase\">\n              <span className=\"pipeline-phase-label\">Visit / Visitor</span>\n              <div className=\"pipeline-flow\">\n                {!isMvp && (<>\n                  <span\n                    className={`pipeline-step ${activePositionSet.has(\"visitBefore\") ? \"pipeline-step-active\" : \"pipeline-step-module-off\"}`}\n                  >\n                    <i className=\"fas fa-code\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Pre-Visitor\n                  </span>\n                  <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                </>)}\n                <span className=\"pipeline-step\">Visit/Visitor Enrichments</span>\n                <span className=\"pipeline-arrow\"><i className=\"fas fa-arrow-right\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /></span>\n                <span\n                  className={`pipeline-step ${activePositionSet.has(\"visitAfterStd\") ? \"\" : \"editor-timing-status-group-off\"}`}>\n                  <div className=\"editor-timing-status-header\">\n                    <span className={`editor-timing-status-icon ${anyCompatible ? \"editor-timing-status-icon-on\" : \"\"}`}>\n                      <i className={`fas ${anyCompatible ? \"fa-check-circle\" : \"fa-minus-circle\"}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                    </span>\n                    <div className=\"editor-timing-status-text\">\n                      <span className=\"editor-timing-status-label\">{g.label}</span>\n                      <span className=\"editor-timing-status-desc\">{g.desc}</span>\n                    </div>\n                  </div>\n                  <div className=\"editor-timing-status-positions\">\n                    {positions.map((pos) => {\n                      const compatible = allowedPositions.includes(pos.id);\n                      const incompatTypes = !compatible ? getIncompatibleTypesForPosition(pos.id, effectiveParams) : [];\n                      return (\n                        <div key={pos.id} className={`editor-timing-status-pos ${compatible ? \"editor-timing-status-pos-on\" : \"editor-timing-status-pos-off\"}`}>\n                          <i className={`fas ${compatible ? \"fa-check\" : \"fa-times\"}`} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                          <span className=\"editor-timing-status-pos-label\">{pos.label}</span>\n                          <span className=\"editor-timing-status-pos-desc\">{pos.desc}</span>\n                          {pos.id === \"preVisitor\" && compatible && (\n                            <span className=\"editor-timing-check-note\">\n                              <i className=\"fas fa-exclamation-circle\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                              Returning visitors only.\n                            </span>\n                          )}\n                          {!compatible && incompatTypes.length > 0 && (\n                            <span className=\"editor-timing-status-pos-reason\">\n                              Unavailable: {incompatTypes.join(\", \")} not supported at this scope\n                            </span>\n                          )}\n                        </div>\n                      );\n                    })}\n                  </div>\n                </div>\n              );\n            })}\n          </div>}\n        </div>\n        </>}\n      </section>\n\n      {/* Bulk Mode */}\n      {!isMvp && <section className=\"editor-section\">\n        <div className=\"editor-section-header editor-section-header-collapsible\" onClick={() => toggle(\"bulk\")}>\n          <h2 className=\"editor-section-title\">\n            <i className={`fas fa-chevron-${collapsed.bulk ? );\n  };\n\n  const handleAddOrGroup = (instId: string) => {\n    setInstances((prev) =>\n      prev.map((inst) => {\n        if (inst.id !== instId) return inst;\n        const groups =
